pageCache.pageTitle: North Bradley CE Primary School - Collective Worship
pageCache.text:
Social Media
Collective Worship
Collective Worship
Collective Worship is an important part of every day at our school. It is a time when we reflect on our lives and God’s love for us. The range of experiences over each week includes:
Monday - whole school collective worship with the Head teacher
Tuesday - whole school collective worship delivered by members of the local clergy and the Baptist Church
Wednesday - collective worship delivered by teachers
Thursday - whole school singing collective worship
Friday - class collective worship - learning about what's going on in the news.
At each collective worship a candle is lit and children are encouraged to think about our Christian Values while these are being lit.
There will always be a time of reflection that is led by the adult to help children to consider the theme of the worship.
Prayers are said; they may be well known such as The Lord’s Prayer or a specific prayer chosen for the theme. Sometimes children are invited to lead a 'spontaneous prayer'.
A hymn is chosen that often reflects the theme of the collective worship.
Sometimes we hold our collective worhip at St Nicholas Church which is next door to the school. These collective worships are led by the local clergy.
The head teacher plans the themes for collective worship, which are followed by all those who lead assemblies.
Collective Worship has an annual action plan that is monitored by Foundation Governors.
Upper Key Stage 2 children are always involved in setting up the hall for collective worship. They ‘set’ the special table with the Bible, candles and there will often be a special artefact as well. They play the music as children come into and leave the hall.
There is always a display in the hall on the current assembly theme.
Our Collective Worship Policy
Our School Prayer has been written by many members of our school community; staff, children, governors and representatives of our 2 local churches;

pageCache.pageTitle: North Bradley CE Primary School - British Values
pageCache.text:
Social Media
British Values
Promoting Fundamental British Values.
In accordance with The Department for Education we aim to actively promote British values in schools to ensure young people leave school prepared for life in modern Britain.
Pupils are encouraged to regard people of all faiths, races and cultures with respect and tolerance and understand that while different people may hold different views about what is ‘right’ and ‘wrong’, all people living in England are subject to its law.
The Key Values are:
democracy
rule of law
individual liberty
mutual respect

pageCache.pageTitle: North Bradley CE Primary School - School Vision and Values
pageCache.text:
Social Media
School Vision and Values
Our Core Values
At North Bradley CE Primary School our school values are underpinned by the teachings found in Paul's letters to the Philippians. Written while Paul was imprisoned for his faith, his letters share a powerful message of hope in the face of adversity. Paul encouraged others to remain positive and 'SHINE as lights in the world' (Philippians 2.15).
We use SHINE to underpin our values and ask that everyone in our community 'SHINE as lights in the world'.
Our Vision
At North Bradley CE Primary, our vision is to SHINE through every child’s journey—striving for excellence, building confidence, and nurturing a love of learning. We hold hope at the heart of school life, creating a calm, welcoming environment where every child feels valued and supported. Inclusion is essential to how we teach and care for our pupils, ensuring all children can access learning, friendships, and opportunities regardless of background or need. We are committed to equality in every aspect of school life, celebrating differences and helping everyone to flourish. Together, we work closely with families to nurture positive relationships, strong character, and a sense of belonging—so children leave us ready to SHINE in their next chapter.

pageCache.pageTitle: North Bradley CE Primary School - About Us
pageCache.text:
Social Media
About Us
Welcome to North Bradley CE Primary
At North Bradley CE Primary, we are committed to fostering an environment where every child can 'SHINE'. We believe in nurturing each student’s potential through a balanced and inclusive educational experience. Our ethos is rooted in values of Strive, Hope, Inclusion, Nurture and Equality, ensuring that every child feels valued and supported in their learning journey.
Our curriculum is designed to inspire curiosity and a love of learning, providing all pupils with the tools they need to thrive academically, socially, and emotionally. We strive to create a community where students not only achieve educational excellence but also develop a sense of responsibility and compassion towards others. At North Bradley, we nurture young minds to become confident, capable, and caring individuals.
Join us in our mission to provide an inclusive education where every child can succeed. We look forward to partnering with you to help your children grow and achieve their dreams in a supportive and enriching environment. Together, we can make a difference in their lives and instill lasting values of; Strive, Hope, Inclusion, Nurture and Equality.

pageCache.pageTitle: North Bradley CE Primary School - Welcome
pageCache.text:
Social Media
Welcome to North Bradley CofE Primary School.
At North Bradley CofE Primary School, we are committed to fostering an environment where every child is given the opportunity to 'SHINE as lights in the world' (Philippians 2.15) . Our dedicated staff strive to deliver a curriculum that is not only enriching and engaging but also inclusive, ensuring that every student feels valued and supported. We believe in nurturing the potential of each child, helping them to develop a love for learning that will last a lifetime.
Our school is built on the principles of hope and equality, where all members of our community are encouraged to strive for excellence. We embrace diversity and work tirelessly to create a welcoming atmosphere where children and parents alike feel a strong sense of belonging. At North Bradley CofE Primary School, inclusion is not just a policy; it is at the heart of everything we do, ensuring that each child can thrive in a supportive environment.
We invite you to join our school community, where your child will be nurtured, respected, and given the tools to succeed in their educational journey. Let us work together to foster a bright future filled with hope and endless possibilities. Welcome to a place where every child can SHINE and strive for greatness, supported by a foundation of inclusion and equality.

School Prospectus
Welcome to North Bradley CE Primary, a vibrant learning community where we strive to offer an inclusive, nurturing environment that fosters hope and equality. Our ethos is built around the belief that every child deserves the opportunity to shine academically, socially, and emotionally. We are committed to providing a rich curriculum tailored to inspire young minds and encourage a lifelong love of learning.
At North Bradley CE Primary, we believe in the power of partnership and collaboration between teachers, parents, and students. Our school is a place where we work together to strive for excellence in every aspect of school life, ensuring that all children feel valued, respected, and supported. Join us on a journey where your child will grow, flourish, and shine, embracing the challenges and opportunities that lie ahead. Please take a look at our prospectus to give you a deeper understanding of who we are.

Creators Class - Year 2
Welcome to Creators Class!
Welcome to Creators Class, I am Miss Croker and I am your child's teacher this year!
Book Change is Monday and Thursday. Please make sure your childs reading book and record are in school on these days.
Your child is expected to be reading daily at home. Please ensure you are discussing what they are reading aloud to aid their comprehension skills.
Homework will be set on a Friday and is due on a Wednesday. Please ensure homework is completed in pencil.
PE Days are Tuesday and Wednesday, please send your child into school in their PE kits on this day to ensure the children get the maximum amount of PE time and to help ease transistions.
